# Pixel Memory Match

A simple, offline memory-match game built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

## Features

- 8 pairs of colored cards (16 cards total)
- Flip two cards at a time; matched pairs stay open
- Move counter
- Win message when all pairs are matched
- "New game" button to reshuffle and restart
- Keyboard accessible: cards are buttons, focusable and operable with Enter/Space
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide

## How to run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server, build step, or internet connection required.

## Controls

- Click or tap a card to flip it.
- Use Tab to move focus between cards and the New game button.
- Press Enter or Space to flip a focused card or activate the button.

## Colors

The game uses a cohesive palette of dark navy, purple, yellow, and neutral tones for clear contrast and hierarchy.
